summary: Regression run after code-quality fixes (MD5->SHA-256 cache key, admin creds via env, stable list keys, logo image swap, Artists moved before Contact). Backend: 14/14 pytest tests passed against public URL. Frontend: home page renders all 6 sections in the new order, 8 artist cards visible, logo image loads in navbar/hero/footer, contact form submission triggers success toast, and no console errors were captured.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes helpers, models, seed data, LLM translation, and routes in a single 350+ line module. Consider splitting into models.py, routers/, services/translation.py, seed.py for maintainability.

translate_strings falls back to unmodified Spanish silently when LLM key balance is 0 or Gemini call fails. This is intended for now, but the response should include a lang/success hint header to help the frontend show a fallback notice.
create_artist inserts an artificial _mongo field then unsets it in a second write; a single insert with exclude _id (or find_one_and_update upsert) is cleaner.
@app.on_event startup/shutdown are deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to the lifespan context manager.
hero-logo / nav-logo / footer-logo images have no alt-text validation in tests; ensure alt='Siroco Producciones' for accessibility.
seed_data_creation: None persistent; test artist and contact records are created and cleaned up (artist CRUD roundtrip deletes its own record; contact TEST_ messages remain in db.contact_messages).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers /api/site (es/en/invalid), /api/contact create + admin persistence + email validation, /api/auth login/me, /api/admin content update, artist CRUD, and messages auth. English translation test takes ~25s due to Gemini call falling back; that is expected. Frontend testids used: nav-logo, hero-logo, contact-name/-email/-subject/-message/-submit, artist-card*.
rca of the issue: No regressions detected after SHA-256 cache key change and section reorder; hashlib.sha256 hex length (64) fits Mongo _id string and invalidates the previous MD5-keyed cache entries (which is fine because translations.delete_many is called on admin updates and the fallback just returns Spanish).
